claim: Meta's Q2 2025 revenue was up 22% year over year.
summary: Meta's Q2 2025 revenue was $47.52 billion versus $39.07 billion in Q2 2024, an increase of approximately 22% year-over-year as reported on July 30, 2025, so the claim that Q2 2025 revenue was up 22% year over year is correct.

sub_claims.text: Meta's Q2 2025 revenue increased 22% year over year
